parent_objective: audit repaired scenario taxonomy execution result before scenario-quality interpretation
blocked_by: need outcome audit before controller-family ranking, task-quality conclusion, or paper-route claim
supersedes: direct controller-family comparison from M1738 raw aggregates

public_gates: M1739 must audit M1738 pass/fail and guardrails before interpreting raw outcomes
M1739 must verify 864 episodes zero failures finite metrics and complete repair provenance aggregates
M1739 must classify whether outcomes are scenario-quality evidence, execution-only evidence, or redesign evidence
M1739 must decide next route: scenario-quality audit, task-quality redesign, branch synthesis, or stop
M1739 must not train replay PPO promote use private holdout change actor inputs tune profiles rank controller families or claim paper-level evidence
forbidden_shortcuts: do not treat unsupported faults as covered

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits M1738 repaired execution outcomes and decides whether to interpret, redesign, synthesize, or stop
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: result audit only; no rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if M1738 did not complete 864 episodes
stop if execution failures or non-finite selected metrics exist
stop if repair provenance or sampled-label aggregates are missing
stop if the audit would rank controller-family profiles directly from public diagnostic rows
fallback_plan: route to scenario-quality interpretation only if execution artifacts and claim boundaries are clean
route to taxonomy/task-quality redesign if outcomes are dominated by non-informative off-track or collision modes
route to branch synthesis if the public branch has reached another evidence decision point
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1738 completed repaired scenario taxonomy execution

training_stage.stage_objective: audit repaired scenario taxonomy execution result
admission_evidence: M1738 executed the repaired 864-cell taxonomy with zero failures and complete aggregates
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim paper-level or level3 self-identification evidence
allowed_updates: M1739 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up route manifest if the audit admits it
next_stage_criteria: M1738 pass/fail and raw outcome distribution are audited

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; M1739 audits task-quality scenario outcomes and cannot prove history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: audit may inspect profile controls but must not turn public diagnostic rows into a self-ID claim
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1738 repaired scenario taxonomy execution artifacts.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If outcomes are dominated by off-track or collision, record task-quality or scenario-quality evidence rather than weakening self-ID claim standards.
allowed_claims: no rollout, training, replay, PPO, private-holdout, promotion, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1738 can be audited as a clean repaired scenario taxonomy execution before any scenario-quality conclusion or controller-family comparison.
success_criteria: M1738 result_class guardrails and aggregate availability are audited
864 episodes zero failures finite metrics and complete repair provenance are audited
outcome and scenario-family distributions are summarized without ranking controller families
next route is scenario-quality audit task-quality redesign branch synthesis or stop
environment rollout training replay PPO promotion private holdout actor-input changes ranking and level3 claims remain blocked
failure_criteria: audit omits M1738 pass/fail or guardrails
audit ranks controller-family profiles from public diagnostic rows
environment rollout training replay PPO private holdout promotion or actor-input changes occur
paper-level or level3 claims are made

commands.name: audit
commands.command: write repaired scenario taxonomy result audit

decision_rule: M1739 passes if it audits M1738 execution results and chooses a route without overclaiming public diagnostic outcomes.
